CompletedNode.js

URL Shortener Engine

High-Performance Link Management Tool

Project Overview

A utility service that generates unique short keys for complex Web links and provides instantaneous redirection while validating incoming URLs.

Problem Statement

Creating an efficient key-generation algorithm with low database read latency and reliable input sanitization.

Solution Approach

Created a Node.js REST service implementing key generation alongside URL validation routines.

Implemented Features

  • Instant custom & randomized short link creation
  • Automated HTTP redirect handling
  • Malicious URL pattern sanitization
  • Clean web UI for generation

Technical Decisions

  • Used Base62 encoding strategy to generate short, collision-resistant string keys.

Known Limitations

  • Basic analytics; does not log deep geo-IP metrics.
